1.label: very_easy
1.summary: Place three large blocks into a wide, single-ring arc with no decoys.

2.label: easy
2.summary: Place four blocks around a single ring while distinguishing one spare block.

3.label: medium
3.summary: Build the current five-block ring-and-ledge structure from changing radial supports.

4.label: hard
4.summary: Place seven blocks across two concentric support rings with two plausible spare blocks.

5.label: very_hard
5.summary: Complete a nine-block, three-ring masonry shell with three spare blocks and tight keyed orientations.

simplified.summary: Select a block from the tray, use visible turn controls, then click a visible landing socket.

full.summary: Drag a block directly around the planet and right-click it to rotate before releasing it.
